summary: Theo refuses to end the shift because he knows something is buried beneath the trench. Vark assumes obsession until the drill strikes an impossible surface and Theo recognizes it before anyone can explain what they have found.

At Zenith Spire, Rae watches a location official history erased reappear in the archive beside a forbidden REDLIN reference. She hides it from Caelum beneath ordinary paperwork and realizes the record is returning rather than being newly created.

Theo touches the Desert Marker and the present is replaced by the last quiet moment before an ancient battle. He sees Starbreaker preparing a catastrophic decisive act, but the memory ends before the act itself. Vark sees only fragments and can no longer dismiss Theo's claims as obsession.

Adrian finds Theo after the memory rupture. Theo demands validation; Adrian's refusal to look at the Marker reveals that he already knows enough to fear it. Adrian will acknowledge that the history was removed, but not why Theo can remember it.

Rae copies the returning records before they can be erased again. Caelum confronts her, but refuses to answer why the location and Redlin reference were missing from history, confirming that the concealment is institutional rather than accidental.

While Theo is treated for his injuries, Vark forces him to confront the lie they are about to tell. Their dry, ordinary argument gives way to Vark choosing to protect the discovery from people neither of them trusts.

Rae searches older records with the stolen drive and finds Adrian already waiting among deliberately sealed histories. He reveals that some history was removed rather than lost, but refuses to tell her why a name from her dreams is returning in the archive.

Theo races to hide the Marker before a patrol reaches Sector Four. Adrian watches until Theo's motive changes from proving the object exists to preventing others from possessing it, then quietly helps him conceal it.

Rae chooses to destroy the stolen records rather than let Caelum reclaim them, accepting that the truth now survives only in memory and in what she chose to notice. Caelum's threat confirms that the institution fears remembered meaning, not merely possession of a file.

Theo buries the Marker and confronts Adrian when he discovers the envoy preserved a record of it. Adrian forces Theo to confront that the dangerous fact is not where the object lies, but that something in the forgotten past recognized him.

Adrian finds Rae after she destroys the archive trail. He helps sever the identity markers that will let the Spire track her and reveals that other people have remembered impossible history before her.

Theo keeps a fragment from the buried Marker and forces Adrian to admit that he too remembers the forgotten sky. The issue ends with Theo knowing the visions belong to shared history, while Adrian still refuses to say why Theo can remember it.
